title: A/R Summary: a name starting with = opens in the CSV as plain text
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an open invoice on today's date, and its name starts with "=" so that it reads like a spreadsheet formula.
    For example: {Customer-A} is =2+3 ZZAUTOTEST S3-30 Formula.
  • A spreadsheet program is installed on the computer.
    For example: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets or LibreOffice Calc.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with the Customer filter showing only {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read {Customer-A}'s name on screen.
  2. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the CSV in the spreadsheet program.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the name shows as it was typed, starting with "=".
  • Step 2: the CSV downloads with the "Success" message.
  • Step 3: the spreadsheet opens the file, and {Customer-A}'s name cell shows the name's own characters as text (a mark may be added in front of them so the spreadsheet keeps them as text); it does not show a calculated number (such as 5) or an error (such as #NAME?).

Why: a name that a spreadsheet would run as a formula is a known risk in exported files; the tech plan says the CSV guards against it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R3: “The PDF and the CSV contain exactly the rows on screen for the chosen as-of date, customer or vendor and locations, in the on-screen sort, including a sort changed after an earlier export, without refreshing the page.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §9 Security: “CSV formula-injection hardening via CsvAttachmentResponseBuilder (system numeric columns masked as safe).”
